messages:
maria: Heads-up — vendor portal bumped our demo-standby waitlist to position 4. Do we want to auto-claim when a slot frees, or hold for priority customers? I also have a small Terraform PR that actually claims the slot; needs a quick review before I merge.

maria: PR link: https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/merge_requests/842 — the claim is under `module/demo_reserve` (tiny change). Example snippet I added:
```hcl
resource "vendor_waitlist_claim" "demo_claim" {
  pool = "demo-standby"
  reason = "smoke-tests / demo"
  billing_tag = "team:platform"
}
```

devon: Is this for APAC or EU racks? If it's APAC I can hold off and let marketing use EU for demos. Any ETA from vendor?

alloc-bot: Waitlist update: pool=demo-standby pos=4 estimated_open_window=6-36h. Auto-claim flag currently=unset. React with :eyes: to confirm auto-claim when available.

lee: I can review the terraform PR today. @maria drop the MR ID here (842) and I'll do a quick pass. Also if auto-claim will consume spare credits, can someone post current credit/budget for demo tag?

maria: thanks @lee — MR 842 is the one. Quick check command I ran for vendor portal: `curl -sS https://vendor.example.com/api/waitlist/demo-standby | jq .position` — returned 4 this morning. Billing snippet to check credits: `gcloud billing budgets describe demo-team-budget --format=json`

oliver: My take — prefer to NOT auto-claim unless we set `billing_tag=demo:urgent` and `owner=platform` so finance can track. If slot opens and we need it for infra smoke-tests only, we should prioritise internal test runs over public demos. Recommendation: auto-claim=false; merge PR but gate apply behind manual step (runbook: infra/ops/claim-waitlist.md). @maria can you rebase and add `billing_tag=demo:urgent` field so we can make a decision quickly?

devon: +1 to manual gate. If we need a quick demo and slot opens, I'll coordinate with marketing. I'll stand by for PR review and smoke-test scheduling. :thumbsup:
